import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(4)

def cs(a, g):
    b = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64) * np.asarray(g, dtype=np.float64)[:, None]
    return b - b.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)

def product_norm(A, B):
    return np.sqrt(max(np.sum((A.T @ A) * (B.T @ B)), 1e-30))

heads = {}
for l in range(12):
    a = W[f"L{l}.qkv.W"]
    g = W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"]
    for h in range(12):
        Q, K, V = [cs(a[:, off+64*h:off+64*(h+1)], g)
                   for off in (0, 768, 1536)]
        O = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.out.W"][64*h:64*(h+1)],
                       dtype=np.float64).copy()
        O -= O.mean(axis=1, keepdims=True)
        heads[l,h] = dict(Q=Q, K=K, V=V, O=O,
                         qkn=product_norm(Q,K), ovn=product_norm(V,O.T))

source = heads[4,11]
_, R = np.linalg.qr(source["V"], mode="reduced")
_, singular, Bt = np.linalg.svd(R @ source["O"], full_matrices=False)
B = Bt.T
print("4.11 OV singular values (coordinate-invariant):")
print(np.round(singular, 4))

targets = [(5,0),(5,3),(5,5),(5,7),(5,9),(6,6),(6,7),
           (7,3),(7,8),(7,11),(8,4),(9,11)]
other_sources = [(1,7),(2,0),(3,5),(3,9),(3,11),(4,6),(4,11)]

def composition(a, Q, K):
    C = a["V"] @ (a["O"] @ K)
    norm = product_norm(Q, C)
    return np.sum(Q*C), np.sum(Q*C)/norm

print("\nKEY EDIT COMPARISON")
print("head method | QK_change_fraction QK_remaining_fraction direct_QK_trace/F "
      "| source_comp_trace source_comp_trace/F | other_source_traces")
for lh in targets:
    b = heads[lh]
    Q, K = b["Q"], b["K"]
    # Minimum change to the QK map that removes its Frobenius
    # alignment with the source OV map.
    D = source["O"].T @ (source["V"].T @ Q)
    direction = np.linalg.solve(Q.T @ Q, D.T).T
    alpha = np.sum(K*D) / np.sum(direction*D)
    variants = [("original", K)]
    for rank in (16,32,64):
        U = B[:,:rank]
        variants.append((f"project{rank}", K-U@(U.T@K)))
    variants.append(("trace_zero", K-alpha*direction))
    for name, Kn in variants:
        changed = product_norm(Q,K-Kn)/b["qkn"] if name != "original" else 0.
        remaining = product_norm(Q,Kn)/b["qkn"]
        direct = np.sum(Q*Kn)/product_norm(Q,Kn)
        tr, align = composition(source,Q,Kn)
        others = [composition(heads[s],Q,Kn)[0] for s in other_sources[:-1]]
        print(f"{lh[0]}.{lh[1]:<2} {name:11s} "
              f"{changed:6.3f} {remaining:6.3f} {direct:7.3f} | "
              f"{tr:8.3f} {align:7.3f} | "
              + " ".join(f"{x:7.2f}" for x in others))

copy_refs = [(5,10),(6,4),(7,0),(8,9),(9,2),(9,6),(10,1),(11,5)]
suppress_refs = [(1,4),(3,6),(4,7),(5,6),(6,5)]
print("\nOV AGREEMENT WITH OTHER COPYING AND SUPPRESSION MAPS")
print("head OV_trace/F | copy-map cosines | negative suppression-map cosines")
for lh in targets + [(4,11),(5,4),(6,0),(7,7),(11,0)]:
    b = heads[lh]
    vals = []
    for ref in copy_refs + suppress_refs:
        a = heads[ref]
        dot = np.sum((a["V"].T@b["V"])*(a["O"]@b["O"].T))
        vals.append(dot/(a["ovn"]*b["ovn"]))
    vals[len(copy_refs):] = [-x for x in vals[len(copy_refs):]]
    print(f"{lh[0]}.{lh[1]:<2} "
          f"{np.trace(b['O']@b['V'])/b['ovn']:7.3f} | "
          + " ".join(f"{x:6.3f}" for x in vals[:len(copy_refs)])
          + " | " + " ".join(f"{x:6.3f}" for x in vals[len(copy_refs):]))

print("\nMINIMUM ABSOLUTE NORM1 SCALE IN TARGET LAYERS")
for l in sorted(set(l for l,h in targets)):
    g = np.asarray(W[f"L{l}.norm1.scale"])
    print(l, float(np.min(np.abs(g))), float(np.median(np.abs(g))))
